data.body:
[P2] Bound residual-task shutdown before producing reports

The coordinator stops waiting for adapter tasks that exceed their budgets and quarantines affected targets. However, `asyncio.run()` subsequently cancels and waits for all remaining tasks without a timeout. An adapter task that continues suppressing cancellation therefore hangs the CLI after collection returns, preventing `build_report()` and report publication despite the configured harness limits. Use an explicitly managed event loop with bounded cancellation and draining while preserving quarantine. Add a CLI regression test with an adapter task that survives repeated cancellation.
